title: Launching and FGD of Affordable Smart Fertigation System, SmartAgri UGM Promotes Climate-Adaptive Agriculture at KWT Teratai Mekar
excerpt: Yogyakarta, October 9, 2026. body:
**Yogyakarta, October 9, 2026.** Smart Agriculture Research Center UGM together with the Faculty of Agricultural Technology (FTP) UGM held a launching and Focus Group Discussion (FGD) of the Affordable Smart Fertigation System at the RW 26 Pringgolayan Community Meeting Hall, Condongcatur, Friday (9/10).

This activity is part of the Bank Indonesia Research Grant (RGBI) program, which aims to introduce simple and affordable agricultural technology to support climate-adaptive agriculture, efficient use of water and fertilizer, and strengthening food security in the community. In addition to technology introduction, the activity included system presentations, equipment handover, technology demonstration, and discussion with members of KWT Teratai Mekar regarding the implementation of the fertigation system in daily agricultural activities.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1046-1-image-1-1030x491.webp)

The event was attended by the Dean of FTP UGM, Prof. Dr. Mirwan Ushada, S.T.P., M.App.Life.Sc., Head of the Department of Agricultural Engineering and Biosystems FTP UGM, Dr. Arifin Dwi Saputro, S.T.P., M.Sc., Prof. Dr. Ir. Lilik Sutiarso, M.Eng., IPU., ASEAN Eng., APEC Eng., as a member of the RGBI research team, Coordinator of Smart Agriculture Research Center UGM and Head of the RGBI 2026 Research Program, Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, Ph.D., IPU., ASEAN Eng., APEC Eng., a representative of Condongcatur Subdistrict, board members of KWT Teratai Mekar, Head of Dukuh Dabag, SmartAgri UGM research team members, and members of KWT Teratai Mekar.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1046-2-image-12-1030x941.webp)

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1046-3-image-13-638x1030.webp)

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1046-4-image-14-641x1030.webp)

In his remarks, a representative of Condongcatur Subdistrict, Murdiyanto, S.E., expressed appreciation for the mentoring and knowledge transfer provided by FTP UGM to the community. According to him, practical agricultural technology is very much needed by the people of Condongcatur, especially since agricultural land is increasingly limited. "In Condongcatur, agricultural land has been decreasing. Therefore, we are grateful for the guidance and knowledge to utilize small yard spaces," he said. He added that the community, especially the women members of KWT, need technology that is easy to use, practical, and delivers tangible results. He hopes that the implementation of the fertigation system can increase the enthusiasm and productivity of KWT Teratai Mekar members.

Ida Halimah, Head of KWT Teratai Mekar, said that the affordable smart fertigation system addresses the challenges that her group has faced, particularly in proper fertilizer application, efficient water use, and production cost control. "We are grateful for the trust given to KWT Teratai Mekar as the location for this technology research and implementation. We hope this system can help us apply fertilizer properly, not waste water, and remain affordable," said Ida.

Meanwhile, Ahmad Sunaryo, Head of Dukuh Dabag, highlighted the spirit and sincerity of KWT Teratai Mekar members in developing agricultural activities together. He stated the motto "The sincerity of these women is what keeps KWT Teratai Mekar moving forward. We thank UGM for the assistance and mentoring that has been provided."

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1046-5-image-8.webp)

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1046-6-image-9.webp)

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1046-7-image-11.webp)

Prof. Lilik, a representative of the RGBI research team, explained that the development of the affordable smart fertigation system stems from the community's need for technology that is simple, easy to use, and inexpensive. According to him, digital technology is often perceived as something complicated, expensive, requiring a lot of electricity, and difficult to maintain. "Therefore, we strive to develop practical technology with maximum results. This technology is designed to be easy to use by KWT women and can be applied in daily agricultural activities," he explained.

Dr. Arifin Dwi Saputro, Head of the Department of Agricultural Engineering and Biosystems FTP UGM, conveyed that the activity is still at the stage of introducing simple technology. With diligence, spirit, and consistency from KWT members in implementing the system, similar technology can be further developed to support increased production and community income.

Prof. Mirwan Ushada, Dean of FTP UGM, stated that climate change has been directly felt by the community, including through changes in rainfall patterns that impact agricultural activities and food sovereignty. He believes that women, especially KWT members, play an important role in ensuring food availability for their families while supporting household economies. Therefore, community involvement in the implementation of agricultural technology is an important part of efforts to build sustainable food security.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1046-8-image-2-1030x464.webp)

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1046-9-image-3-1030x513.webp)

In the presentation session, Dr. Andri Prima Nugroho, Coordinator of Smart Agriculture Research Center UGM and Head of the RGBI 2026 Research Program, explained that the fertigation system was selected based on problems found in the field.

Some of these problems include the need for alternate irrigation, the heavy workload of irrigation, inconsistent fertilizer application, and difficulties in fertilizer procurement. The affordable smart fertigation system was developed to help address these problems through technology that can be operated digitally using mobile phones or manually.

Technology introduction is carried out gradually to match user needs and capabilities. "Hopefully, this technology can ease the work of these women operationally, increase time productivity, and support increased income and plant quality," said Andri.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1046-10-image-1030x497.webp)

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1046-11-image-4-1030x468.webp)

Following the remarks and technology presentation session, the activity continued with a visit to the KWT Teratai Mekar garden in Dabag. At this location, the handover and launching of the Affordable Smart Fertigation System took place, marked by the initial operation of the equipment by representatives from the subdistrict government, FTP UGM, research team members, and KWT Teratai Mekar board members.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1046-12-image-5-1030x534.webp)

The research team then provided a simple demonstration on how to use the fertigation system to KWT members. This demonstration aimed to enable KWT members to understand how to operate, monitor, and maintain the system in daily cultivation activities.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1046-13-image-6-1030x524.webp)

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1046-14-image-7-1030x443.webp)

The series of activities concluded with an FGD with KWT Teratai Mekar members. The discussion covered the use of AURORA as well as agricultural activities carried out by KWT Teratai Mekar. This FGD was also attended by research assistants from Smart Agriculture Research Center UGM, namely Ardan Wiratmoko, S.T.P., M.Sc., Athala Fawwaz, Fathuzaky Setyawan, Samuel Gatot Murseno, Cahyo Putro, Fahmi Arsyad, M. Fajar Ridho, Mutiara Alifia, Diena Itaul, Ardan Desta, and Rizqi Asy'ari.

Additionally, SmartAgri UGM researchers who will conduct research at KWT Teratai Mekar, namely Maoricio Ferrel, Adimas Dwi, and Iskandar Zulkarnain, also participated in the activity. Through this FGD, the research team gathered experiences, needs, and input from KWT members as a basis for developing technology more suited to community conditions.

The implementation of the Affordable Smart Fertigation System at KWT Teratai Mekar is expected to be an initial step toward developing efficient, practical, and climate-adaptive home garden agriculture. This activity is also expected to strengthen collaboration between higher education institutions, government, community, and Bank Indonesia in supporting food security and improving community welfare.

Connection to SDGs

-   **SDG 2 – Zero Hunger**, through strengthening food security and increasing agricultural productivity in the community.
-   **SDG 5 – Gender Equality**, through empowering KWT women in technology management and agricultural activities.
-   **SDG 9 – Industry, Innovation, and Infrastructure**, through the development and implementation of simple and affordable smart fertigation technology.
-   **SDG 12 – Responsible Consumption and Production**, through efficient use of water and fertilizer in the cultivation process.
-   **SDG 13 – Climate Action**, through the implementation of agricultural technology that supports cultivation systems adaptive to climate change.
-   **SDG 17 – Partnerships for the Goals**, through collaboration between UGM, Bank Indonesia, subdistrict government, research team members, and the KWT Teratai Mekar community.

original.body:
**Yogyakarta, 9 Oktober 2026.** Smart Agriculture Research Center UGM bersama Fakultas Teknologi Pertanian (FTP) UGM melaksanakan launching dan Focus Group Discussion (FGD) Sistem Fertigasi Cerdas Terjangkau di Balai Pertemuan Warga RW 26 Pringgolayan, Condongcatur, Jumat (9/10).

Kegiatan tersebut merupakan bagian dari program Research Grant Bank Indonesia (RGBI) yang bertujuan memperkenalkan teknologi pertanian sederhana dan terjangkau untuk mendukung pertanian adaptif iklim, efisiensi penggunaan air dan pupuk, serta penguatan ketahanan pangan masyarakat. Selain pengenalan teknologi, kegiatan tersebut diisi dengan pemaparan sistem, serah terima alat, demonstrasi penggunaan teknologi, dan diskusi bersama anggota KWT Teratai Mekar mengenai penerapan sistem fertigasi dalam kegiatan pertanian sehari-hari.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1046-1-image-1-1030x491.webp)

Acara dihadiri oleh Dekan FTP UGM, Prof. Dr. Mirwan Ushada, S.T.P., M.App.Life.Sc., Ketua Departemen Teknik Pertanian dan Biosistem FTP UGM, Dr. Arifin Dwi Saputro, S.T.P., M.Sc., Prof. Dr. Ir. Lilik Sutiarso, M.Eng., IPU., ASEAN Eng., APEC Eng., selaku anggota tim peneliti RGBI, Koordinator Smart Agriculture Research Center UGM sekaligus Ketua Program Penelitian RGBI 2026, Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, Ph.D., IPU., ASEAN Eng., APEC Eng., perwakilan Kelurahan Condongcatur, pengurus KWT Teratai Mekar, Ketua Dukuh Dabag, tim peneliti SmartAgri UGM, serta anggota KWT Teratai Mekar.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1046-2-image-12-1030x941.webp)

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1046-3-image-13-638x1030.webp)

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1046-4-image-14-641x1030.webp)

Dalam sambutannya, perwakilan Kelurahan Condongcatur, Murdiyanto, S.E., menyampaikan apresiasi atas pendampingan dan transfer pengetahuan yang diberikan FTP UGM kepada masyarakat. Menurutnya,teknologi pertanian yang praktis sangat dibutuhkan oleh masyarakat Condongcatur, terutama karena lahan pertanian semakin terbatas. “Di Condongcatur, lahan pertanian sudah semakin berkurang. Karena itu, kami berterima kasih atas bimbingan dan ilmu untuk memanfaatkan ruang-ruang pekarangan kecil,” ujarnya. Ia menambahkan bahwa masyarakat, khususnya ibu-ibu KWT, membutuhkan teknologi yang mudah digunakan, praktis, dan memberikan hasil nyata. Ia berharap penerapan sistem fertigasi tersebut dapat meningkatkan semangat serta produktivitas anggota KWT Teratai Mekar.

Ketua KWT Teratai Mekar, Ida Halimah, mengatakan bahwa sistem fertigasi cerdas terjangkau menjawab tantangan yang selama ini dihadapi kelompoknya, khususnya dalam pemberian pupuk secara tepat, efisiensi penggunaan air, serta pengendalian biaya produksi. “Kami berterima kasih atas kepercayaan yang diberikan kepada KWT Teratai Mekar sebagai lokasi penelitian dan penerapan teknologi ini. Kami berharap sistem ini dapat membantu memberikan pupuk secara tepat, tidak boros air, dan tetap terjangkau,” tutur Ida.

Sementara itu, Ketua Dukuh Dabag, Ahmad Sunaryo, menyoroti semangat dan keikhlasan anggota KWT Teratai Mekar dalam mengembangkan kegiatan pertanian bersama. Ia menyebut semboyan “Keikhlasan ibu-ibu inilah yang membuat KWT Teratai Mekar terus maju. Kami mengucapkan terima kasih kepada UGM atas bantuan dan pendampingan yang telah diberikan,”.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1046-5-image-8.webp)

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1046-6-image-9.webp)

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1046-7-image-11.webp)

Perwakilan tim peneliti RGBI, Prof. Lilik, menjelaskan bahwa pengembangan sistem fertigasi cerdas terjangkau berangkat darikebutuhan masyarakat terhadap teknologi yang sederhana, mudah digunakan, dan tidak mahal. Menurutnya, teknologi digital sering kali dipersepsikan sebagai sesuatu yang rumit, mahal, membutuhkan banyak listrik, serta sulit dirawat. “Oleh karena itu, kami berusaha mengembangkan teknologi yang praktis dengan hasil maksimal. Teknologi ini dibuat agar mudah digunakan oleh ibu-ibu KWT dan dapat diterapkan dalam kegiatan pertanian sehari-hari,” jelasnya.

Ketua Departemen Teknik Pertanian dan Biosistem FTP UGM, Dr. Arifin Dwi Saputro, menyampaikan bahwa kegiatan tersebut masih berada pada tahap pengenalan teknologi sederhana. Dengan ketekunan, semangat, dan konsistensi anggota KWT dalam menerapkan sistem, teknologi serupa dapat dikembangkan lebih lanjut untuk mendukung peningkatan produksi dan pendapatan masyarakat.

Dekan FTP UGM, Prof. Mirwan Ushada, mengatakan bahwa perubahan iklim telah dirasakan secara langsung oleh masyarakat, termasuk melalui perubahan pola hujan yang berdampak pada kegiatan pertanian dan kedaulatan pangan. Ia menilai perempuan, khususnya ibu-ibu KWT, memiliki peran penting dalam menjaga ketersediaan pangan keluarga sekaligus mendukung perekonomian rumah tangga. Karena itu, keterlibatan masyarakat dalam penerapan teknologi pertanian menjadi bagian penting dari upaya membangun ketahanan pangan yang berkelanjutan.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1046-8-image-2-1030x464.webp)

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1046-9-image-3-1030x513.webp)

Dalam sesi pemaparan, Koordinator Smart Agriculture Research Center UGM sekaligus Ketua Program Penelitian RGBI 2026, Dr. Andri Prima Nugroho, menjelaskan bahwa sistem fertigasi dipilih berdasarkan permasalahan yang ditemukan di lapangan.

Beberapa permasalahan tersebut antara lain kebutuhan penyiraman secara bergantian, beratnya pekerjaan penyiraman, pemberian pupuk yang belum seragam, serta kendala dalam pengadaan pupuk. Sistem fertigasi cerdas terjangkau dikembangkan untuk membantu mengatasi permasalahan tersebut melalui teknologi yang dapat dioperasikan secara digital menggunakan telepon seluler maupun secara manual.

Pengenalan teknologi dilakukan secara bertahap agar sesuai dengan kebutuhan dan kemampuan pengguna. “Harapannya, teknologi ini dapat memudahkan pekerjaan ibu-ibu secara operasional, meningkatkan produktivitas waktu, serta mendukung peningkatan pendapatan dan kualitas tanaman,” ujar Andri.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1046-10-image-1030x497.webp)

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1046-11-image-4-1030x468.webp)

Setelah sesi sambutan dan pemaparan teknologi, kegiatan dilanjutkan dengan kunjungan ke kebun KWT Teratai Mekar di Dabag. Di lokasi tersebut dilakukan serah terima dan launching Sistem Fertigasi Cerdas Terjangkau yang ditandai dengan pengoperasian awal alat oleh perwakilan pemerintah kelurahan, FTP UGM, tim peneliti, dan pengurus KWT Teratai Mekar.  

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1046-12-image-5-1030x534.webp)

Tim peneliti kemudian memberikan demonstrasi sederhana mengenai penggunaan sistem fertigasi kepada anggota KWT. Demonstrasi tersebut bertujuan agar anggota KWT dapat memahami cara mengoperasikan, memantau, dan merawat sistem dalam kegiatan budi daya sehari-hari.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1046-13-image-6-1030x524.webp)

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1046-14-image-7-1030x443.webp)

Rangkaian kegiatan ditutup dengan FGD bersama anggota KWT Teratai Mekar. Diskusi tersebut membahas penggunaan AURORA serta aktivitas pertanian yang dijalankan oleh KWT Teratai Mekar. FGD ini juga diikuti oleh asisten peneliti Smart Agriculture Research Center UGM, yaitu Ardan Wiratmoko, S.T.P., M.Sc., Athala Fawwaz, Fathuzaky Setyawan, Samuel Gatot Murseno, Cahyo Putro, Fahmi Arsyad, M. Fajar Ridho, Mutiara Alifia, Diena Itaul, Ardan Desta, dan Rizqi Asy’ari. 

Selain itu, peneliti Smart Agriculture UGM yang akan melakukan penelitian di KWT Teratai Mekar, yaitu Maoricio Ferrel, Adimas Dwi, dan Iskandar Zulkarnain, turut mengikuti kegiatan tersebut. Melalui FGD ini, tim peneliti menggali pengalaman, kebutuhan, dan masukan dari anggota KWT sebagai dasar pengembangan teknologi yang lebih sesuai dengan kondisi masyarakat.

Penerapan Sistem Fertigasi Cerdas Terjangkau di KWT Teratai Mekar diharapkan dapat menjadi langkah awal pengembangan pertanian pekarangan yang efisien, praktis, dan adaptif terhadap perubahan iklim. Kegiatan ini juga diharapkan memperkuat kolaborasi antara perguruan tinggi, pemerintah, masyarakat, dan Bank Indonesia dalam mendukung ketahanan pangan serta peningkatan kesejahteraan masyarakat.

Keterkaitan dengan SDGs 

-   **SDG 2 – Tanpa Kelaparan**, melalui penguatan ketahanan pangan dan peningkatan produktivitas pertanian masyarakat.
-   **SDG 5 – Kesetaraan Gender**, melalui pemberdayaan ibu-ibu KWT dalam pengelolaan teknologi dan kegiatan pertanian.
-   **SDG 9 – Industri, Inovasi, dan Infrastruktur**, melalui pengembangan serta penerapan teknologi fertigasi cerdas yang sederhana dan terjangkau.
-   **SDG 12 – Konsumsi dan Produksi yang Bertanggung Jawab**, melalui efisiensi penggunaan air dan pupuk dalam proses budi daya.
-   **SDG 13 – Penanganan Perubahan Iklim**, melalui penerapan teknologi pertanian yang mendukung sistem budi daya adaptif terhadap perubahan iklim.
-   **SDG 17 – Kemitraan untuk Mencapai Tujuan**, melalui kolaborasi antara UGM, Bank Indonesia, pemerintah kelurahan, tim peneliti, dan masyarakat KWT Teratai Mekar.
